title: EBC Annex 41: Whole Building Heat-Air-Moisture Response (MoistEng), Project Summary Report
publisher: IEA Energy in Buildings and Communities Programme

doi.absence_reason: The official project page and report do not identify a DOI.

license.name: Publicly downloadable IEA EBC project report; detailed reuse license not stated

units.absolute_humidity: kilogram water per kilogram dry air in reported exercise plots

measurement_uncertainty.description: The project summary shows representative measurement and simulation curves but does not provide variable-level measurement uncertainty for incorporation into NexusEP.

known_gaps: The summary does not provide complete machine-readable inputs or reference outputs for each common exercise.
Licensing and availability of every underlying common-exercise file remain unverified, so no raw exercise dataset is incorporated.
NexusEP lacks material moisture buffering, latent thermal feedback, condensation, and non-isothermal envelope HAM transport.
The Phase 4.16 fixture uses only the published non-buffering isothermal chamber structure and an explicitly authored moisture pulse; it is not an empirical Annex 41 result.

preprocessing.description: Verify the exact IEA EBC Annex 41 project-summary PDF by signature, byte size, and SHA-256 without redistributing source content or derived data.

permitted_use.purpose: Scope definition and analytical isothermal non-buffering moisture verification
permitted_use.notes: Do not redistribute the report or underlying exercise files through NexusEP until their specific reuse terms are confirmed. Keep the raw report ignored.
